# CG-RES-006: Response enum value added

A response value may take new enumerated values (or the enum was removed).

**Why it matters:** Exhaustive-switch consumers break, tolerant ones do not (§10.4).

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.enumChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | yes |

## Message

> {where} may now return {values}.
>
> Consumers that handle the enum exhaustively may not handle the new values.
>
> **Fix:** Document the enum as extensible (x-extensible-enum) or make sure consumers have a fallback.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: status gains deleted

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [active, suspended]}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [active, suspended, deleted]}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) may now return deleted.

### Fires: x-extensible-enum honored

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a], x-extensible-enum: true}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b], x-extensible-enum: true}}}}}
```

**Result:** Non-breaking, info. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) may now return b.

### Does not fire: values reordered

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [a, b]}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, enum: [b, a]}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- Exhaustive handling in consumers is unknown.
